breakthrough: Personal memory extends beyond typed conversations
lane: Memory, context, connectors, and long-horizon intelligence
outcome: Turn images, audio, screens, files, and device signals into searchable episodes

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Sensory Memory Ingest Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Sensory Memory Ingest Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed entities, capabilities, jobs, events, state transitions, and outputs required to turn images, audio, screens, files, and device signals into searchable episodes, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for episodic memory, semantic recall, multimodal context, personal continuity, and reusable learned skills; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Sensory Memory Ingest Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: turn images, audio, screens, files, and device signals into searchable episodes.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Sensory Memory Ingest Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Sensory Memory Ingest Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using graph retrieval, temporal embeddings, compression, prediction, and counterfactual simulation.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Sensory Memory Ingest Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the memory timeline, recall lens, context diff, and cross-device memory controls, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Sensory Memory Ingest into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Sensory Memory Ingest Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Sensory Memory Ingest Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: Personal memory extends beyond typed conversations. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.

title: Sensory Memory Ingest
